tests.details: Validated pure IEC 61131-3 ST POU 'SunburstPartitionCanvasSync' with STParser & SecurityGuard across %R2130..%R2137 and %M497..%M498.
Rejected 6 forbidden ladder logic constructs (contacts, coils, rungs, networks, mnemonics) with LadderForbiddenError.
Verified 1200x750 viewport, bounds (20, 86, 1160, 644), center (600, 408), 3 annular tiers (70..140, 150..220, 230..300) within bounds.
Verified 14 sectors across 3 tiers (3 Areas, 4 Unit Ops, 7 Sub-Equipments): strictly nested angular spans summing to 360.0 deg and 4250 kW total load.
Generated valid W3C SVG 1.1 graphic (14 annular wedge paths with M, A, L, A, Z commands) -> artifacts/HMI/sunburst_partition_canvas_sample.svg.
Verified WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast compliance: text contrast 19.15:1 (> 7:1) and decoupled badge contrast 20.01:1 (> 18:1).
Verified %M498 alarm trip when load share > 35.0% or efficiency < 75.0%, and nominal de-assertion on recovery.
Verified 0xFA01 (Hierarchy Levels), 0xFA02 (Total Load), 0xFA03 (Angle Sum), 0xFA04 (Canvas Overflow) latched into %R2137 and recovery.
Verified %R2130..%R2137 and %M497..%M498 bit-exact synchronization, and 100 deterministic scan cycles without memory drift or NaN.
